name: nexus_get_game
description:
Get details for one game: stats, download counts, and file/mod categories [v1 - uses v1 REST quota].

Returns:
    JSON object with game info including a 'categories' list (category_id,
    name, parent_category).

domain_name.description: Nexus Mods game domain (lowercase URL slug), e.g. 'forzahorizon6', 'skyrimse'. NOT the display name.
domain_name.title: Domain Name
